name: napkin
description: A blank napkin you can sketch on, so a rough drawing can answer a question that words are doing badly.

interface.shortDescription: Sketch it instead of describing it
interface.longDescription: When words are doing badly, Napkin hands you a blank napkin in the conversation. Draw on it, press Send, and the sketch arrives as an image in your next message.
defaultPrompt: Give me a napkin so I can sketch this
